assertion.statement: Starting in Kyverno 1.13, when Kyverno auto-generates a ValidatingAdmissionPolicy from a policy that uses validate.cel, the resources listed in matching PolicyExceptions are added to the generated policy's matchConstraints.excludeResourceRules field.
